{{Infobox fish |eng = Catfish |location = River • [[Secret Woods]] • [[Witch's Swamp]] |time = 6am - 12am |season = {{Season|Spring}} • {{Season|Fall}} '''[[Secret Woods]]/[[Witch's Swamp]]:'''
{{Season|Spring}} • {{Season|Summer}} • {{Season|Fall}} '''Only with [[Rain Totem]]:''' {{Season|Winter}} |weather = Rain |difficulty = 75 |behavior = Mixed |size = 12-73 |price = 200 |edibility = 20 |roe = Dark Gray }} The '''Catfish''' is a [[fish]] that can be caught in the river (in [[Pelican Town]] or [[Cindersap Forest]]), and the [[Farm Maps|Riverlands Farm]], [[Farm Maps|Forest Farm]], or [[Farm Maps|Hill-Top Farm]] during [[Spring]] and [[Fall]] when raining, or in the [[Secret Woods]] or [[Witch's Swamp]] during [[Spring]], [[Summer]], and [[Fall]] when raining. It can also be caught in [[Winter]] at these locations if a [[Rain Totem]] is used. It can also be acquired from the following: *A [[Animals#Pets|pet]] cat with max [[Animals#Friendship|friendship]] may gift it to the player. *[[Garbage Can]]s may randomly contain one during Spring and Fall. *The [[Traveling Cart]] may randomly sell one for {{Tprice|200}}. *[[Linus]] may randomly send a Catfish in the mail as a gift. *One Catfish is contained in the [[Bundles#Fish Tank|Community Center Fish Tank]] right after the Community Center is repaired. Catfish can be caught regardless of weather, time, or season using [[Magic Bait]]. ==Map== The Catfish can be found in the river, in the Secret Woods pond when it's raining, and in the Witch's Swamp. {{Map|10|100|loc2x=200|loc2y=150|loc3x=120|loc3y=150}} ==Gifting== {{GiftsByItem |dislike=Robin,Maru,Caroline,Abigail,Alex,George,Lewis,Clint,Penny,Emily,Jas,Vincent,Jodi,Kent,Sam,Leah,Shane,Marnie,Gus,Dwarf,Wizard,Harvey,Sandy,Krobus |neutral=Demetrius,Sebastian,Linus,Pam,Elliott,Leo |hate=Pierre,Evelyn,Haley |love=Willy }} ==Bundles== Catfish is used in the {{Bundle|River Fish||y}}. ==Recipes== {{Recipes|header|hide=buff,duration}} {{:Maki Roll|RecipeRow/NoBuffs}} {{:Quality Fertilizer|RecipeRow/NoBuffs}} {{:Sashimi|RecipeRow/NoBuffs}} {{Recipes|footer}} ==Tailoring== Catfish can be used in the spool of the [[2 Willow Lane#Sewing Machine|Sewing Machine]] to create the dyeable [[Tailoring|Fish Shirt]]. [[File:Shirt158.png|24px]] ==Fish Pond== Catfish can be placed in a [[Fish Pond]], where they will reproduce every 4 days. The initial pond capacity is 3 fish, but the capacity can be increased to 10 by completing three quests. The only possible output is dark gray Catfish [[Roe]].
